inputs.description: Multi-object CRM export: Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Cases

summary.headline: Your object graph isn't safe for AI routing yet — 5 integrity breaks on the lead→opp→case spine need repair first.
summary.narrative: Across five objects we found a severed conversion seam, two foreign keys pointing at accounts that don't exist, an unroutable orphaned opportunity, an orphan contact, and a duplicated account identity. Each one is a place an AI agent would route work to nothing, or split one customer across two records. Fix the broken lead→opportunity seam first — it is the seam an AI relies on to follow a handoff a human believes already happened.

findings.title: Lead LD-4003 converted to an opportunity that does not exist
findings.what_we_found: Lead LD-4003 (c@initech.test) has converted_opp_id OPP-9999, but no opportunity OPP-9999 exists in the export — the lead→opportunity conversion seam is severed.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: An AI following the handoff from this lead lands on nothing. It cannot advance the deal, attribute the source, or trigger the next-stage action a human believes already happened.
the_fix: Identify the real opportunity this lead converted to (match on email domain initech.test and conversion date).
Re-link LD-4003.converted_opp_id to that opportunity, or mark the conversion failed and re-run lead conversion so the seam is rebuilt.
Add a validation that converted_opp_id must reference an existing opportunity.
findings.evidence: LD-4003.converted_opp_id = OPP-9999; OPP-9999 absent from Opportunities.

findings.title: Two foreign keys point at accounts that don't exist (ACC-99, ACC-77)
findings.what_we_found: Contact CON-03 references account ACC-99 and case CS-1099 references account ACC-77, but neither ACC-99 nor ACC-77 exists in the Accounts object.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: An AI resolving the account for this contact or case follows a pointer to nothing — it cannot determine ownership, entitlement, or which customer the case belongs to, so it routes the work incorrectly or stalls.
the_fix: Resolve each dangling FK: reparent CON-03 and CS-1099 to their correct existing accounts (look up by company/domain).
If the referenced account legitimately should exist, create it and backfill the relationship.
Add a referential-integrity check so child records cannot be saved against a non-existent account.

findings.title: Opportunity OPP-2050 has no account
findings.what_we_found: Opportunity OPP-2050 ('Mystery Deal') has a blank account_id — it is not attached to any account.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: Revenue with no parent account is unroutable: an AI cannot determine the owner, the customer relationship, or the entitlements, so it cannot advance or attribute the deal.
the_fix: Assign OPP-2050 to its correct account (look up by deal name / contact).
If no account can be determined, quarantine the opportunity out of the AI's routable set until a parent is assigned.
Make account required on opportunity creation to prevent recurrence.

findings.title: Duplicate account identity: ACC-03 'Initech' vs ACC-03b 'Initech Inc'
findings.what_we_found: ACC-03 ('Initech') and ACC-03b ('Initech Inc') are the same company stored as two records; ACC-03b is explicitly marked duplicate_of ACC-03.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: An AI reasoning over this customer sees two half-pictures — opportunities, contacts, and cases split across two identities — so it under-counts pipeline, mis-attributes activity, and may contact the same customer twice.
the_fix: Merge ACC-03b into the surviving master ACC-03 and repoint all child records (contacts, opportunities, cases).
Add a duplicate-prevention rule (match on normalized company name + domain) so the AI sees one customer identity.
Run a one-time dedup sweep on Accounts to catch other near-duplicates.

findings.title: Contact CON-04 has no account
findings.what_we_found: Contact CON-04 (Dana Liu) has a blank account_id — it is not attached to any account.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: An AI cannot place this contact in a customer context, so any routing, scoring, or outreach decision about them is ungrounded.
the_fix: Associate CON-04 with the correct account (look up by email domain).
If the contact is truly accountless (e.g. a personal lead), route them through lead handling rather than leaving an orphan contact.
Make account association part of contact-creation hygiene.
